meta.name: prototype
meta.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速搭建原型验证设计想法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手开发前快速验证界面或交互逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Quickly build a prototype to validate design ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly test interface or interaction logic before development

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你快速搭建一个用完即弃的小程序，用来验证某个设计想法是否靠谱。它只关注回答一个问题，不写测试、不保存数据，做完就删。
howto.when: 当你想快速验证一段逻辑或界面设计是否合理，而不是写正式代码时，可以触发这个技能。

say.text: 帮我搭个原型，验证这个用户登录流程的逻辑对不对。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个终端交互程序来测试状态机。

say.text: 我想看看这个商品详情页有哪几种不同的视觉方案。
say.note: Claude 会生成多个 UI 变体，可通过参数切换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you quickly build a throwaway mini-app to test a design idea. It focuses on answering one question, skips tests and persistence, and is meant to be deleted after use.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you want to quickly sanity-check a logic or UI design, not write production code.

say_en.text: Build a prototype to verify this login flow logic.
say_en.note: Claude will create a terminal app to test the state machine.

say_en.text: Show me several different visual layouts for this product page.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multiple UI variants switchable via a parameter.
